goal: Iske baad aap samjha sakte hain ke recursion kya hai, base case aur recursive case ke naam bata sakte hain, call stack ko barhte aur wapas simatte hue follow kar sakte hain, aur countdown aur factorial jaise simple recursive functions likh sakte hain.
warmup: Aap fee counter par ek lambi queue mein khare hain aur apni position jaanna chahte hain. Aap ko aage ka sira nazar nahi aata, is liye aap apne se aage wale se poochte hain: "Aap ki position kya hai?" Usay bhi nahi pata, to woh apne se aage wale se poochta hai, aur isi tarah aage. Aakhir mein pehla banda kehta hai "Main number 1 hoon." Ab jawab wapas aate hain: doosra kehta hai 2, teesra kehta hai 3, aur aakhir mein aap ko apna number mil jata hai. Kisi ne poori problem hal nahi ki. Har banday ne sirf apne aage wale ke jawab mein 1 add kiya. Yehi recursion hai.
definition: Recursion ka matlab hai ke function khud ko call karta hai taake usi problem ka chhota version hal ho. Har recursive function ke do hisse hote hain. BASE CASE sab se aasaan surat hai, jis ka jawab function khud ko call kiye baghair seedha de deta hai. Yehi process ko rokta hai. RECURSIVE CASE woh hissa hai jahan function chhoti input ke saath khud ko call karta hai, taake har call base case ke qareeb pohanchti jaye. Computer saari intezar karti calls ka hisab ek memory area mein rakhta hai jise call stack kehte hain.
howItWorks: Visual aur traces mein factorial(4) ko follow karein. NEECHE jate hue: factorial(4) abhi jawab nahi de sakta kyunke usay factorial(3) chahiye, to woh usay call karta hai aur intezar karta hai. factorial(3), factorial(2) ka intezar karta hai, aur factorial(2), factorial(1) ka. Har call call stack par ek alag frame hai jis mein n ki apni ALAG copy hoti hai (4, 3, 2, 1), is liye yeh kabhi mix nahi hote. factorial(1) par base case seedha 1 jawab deta hai. UPAR aate hue (ise unwinding kehte hain): factorial(1) 1 return karta hai, to factorial(2) apna 2 * 1 = 2 mukammal kar leta hai, phir factorial(3) apna 3 * 2 = 6, phir factorial(4) apna 4 * 6 = 24. Har frame return hone ke baad khatam ho jata hai. Dhyan dein ke code KAB chalta hai. Recursive call se PEHLE likha hua code neeche jate hue chalta hai. Uske BAAD likha hua code upar aate hue, ulte order mein chalta hai (in/out example dekhein). Recursion versus loop: factorial ka loop version ek frame aur ek counter use karta hai, is liye aam tor par tez hota hai aur kam memory leta hai. Jab problem khud apne terms mein define ho to recursion aksar chhota aur zyada natural code deti hai. Khatra: agar base case na ho, ya calls us tak kabhi na pohanchen, to function hamesha khud ko call karta rehta hai. Har call ko stack memory chahiye, is liye aakhir mein stack khatam ho jata hai aur program crash ho jata hai. Is crash ko stack overflow kehte hain. (Hum yahan sirf bata rahe hain; aisa program kabhi run na karein.)
